high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "@wealth." The post was made 5 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The background features a person standing on a stage with a large "Amazon" logo behind them. The individual appears to be dressed formally in a dark suit jacket over a white shirt. The text overlay on the image is prominently displayed in bold yellow and white fonts. It reads: "TRENDING AMAZON BECOMES 5TH US COMPANY TO SURPASS $2T IN MARKET CAP" This indicates that Amazon has achieved a significant milestone by becoming the fifth U.S. company
